next_step_experiment_plan.name: level2_regime_mapping_plan
next_step_experiment_plan.purpose: Map the boundary between extinction, exclusion takeover, delayed front collapse, and bounded continuation for Level 2 under a frozen metric layer.

current_status.current_anchor_result: robust collapse at tested parameter point
current_status.interpretation: parameter point appears outside bounded continuation window
current_status.immediate_need: controlled regime mapping, not more ad hoc runs

governance.rule: Do not change metrics mid-scan unless a true correctness bug is found.

regime_classes.name: rapid_extinction
regime_classes.definition: rho collapses quickly, active_fraction drops strongly, no persistent finite-width interface survives.

regime_classes.name: global_exclusion_takeover
regime_classes.definition: active exclusion-dominated region spreads across most active nodes and eventually eliminates competing interface structure.
diagnostic_signs: active_fraction remains nontrivial for a while
front may exist transiently before disappearing

regime_classes.name: delayed_front_collapse
regime_classes.definition: a front forms and persists transiently, but later sharpens, destabilizes, or collapses into extinction or exclusion completion.
diagnostic_signs: late-time collapse of width or activity

regime_classes.name: bounded_continuation
regime_classes.definition: a finite-width active interface persists over long times with bounded velocity and without runaway invalidity.
diagnostic_signs: interface_count remains nonzero over long time window
front width stays finite and bounded away from zero
no collapse of rho to zero everywhere

classification_rules.note: Thresholds below are placeholders and should be frozen before batch execution.
decision_order: Check invalid termination or gross numerical failure first
Check if active_fraction collapses to active_low or below -> rapid_extinction
Check if excluded_active_fraction exceeds excluded_active_high on active nodes and interface disappears -> global_exclusion_takeover
Check if front persists transiently but fails late -> delayed_front_collapse
Otherwise if front remains active, finite-width, bounded-speed, and stable over late window -> bounded_continuation

tests.name: dead_domain_test
tests.goal: Ensure near-zero epsilon and rho do not register false exclusion takeover.

tests.name: malformed_state_rejection
tests.goal: Ensure size mismatch is rejected immediately.

tests.name: stationary_interface_test
tests.goal: Ensure front detector can report persistent interface with near-zero velocity.

tests.name: traveling_front_surrogate
tests.goal: Ensure front position and velocity reporting behave sensibly.

tests.name: negative_blowup_test
tests.goal: Ensure symmetric invalid detection catches large negative excursions.

scan_strategy.principle: Coarse first, refine only where qualitative transitions appear.

scan_phases.goal: Confirm current anchor point still collapses under frozen metric layer.
Find first transition boundaries around anchor.
scan_phases.method: Vary one parameter at a time while holding others at anchor values.

scan_phases.goal: Test whether finite-width front survival depends on diffusion structure.
Densely sample only where class boundaries or candidate bounded windows appear.

lam.reason: Likely strong control on exclusion forcing vs survivability.

kappa.reason: Likely affects sharpening, collapse tendency, or interface rigidity.

D_eps.reason: May widen fronts and suppress singular sharpening.

D_rho.reason: May alter recovery, persistence, and suppression of dead-domain collapse.

phase_P1_anchor_confirmation.config: anchor point x 3 IC x 2 seeds

phase_P2_one_parameter_sweeps.estimate_logic: ((5 lam values + 4 kappa values + 5 gamma values) x 3 IC x 2 seeds)

phase_P3_diffusion_balance.estimate_logic: ((4 D_eps values + 4 D_rho values) x 3 IC x 2 seeds)

phase_P4_boundary_refinement.rule: Only near suspected class transitions or candidate R4 windows

regime_map.purpose: Two-parameter or one-parameter slice table showing dominant regime class by parameter setting.
example_views: lam vs kappa at fixed gamma, D_eps, D_rho
gamma vs lam at fixed kappa, D_eps, D_rho
D_eps vs D_rho at fixed gamma, lam, kappa

decision_points.action: Stop and audit code or metrics before broader scan.

decision_points.condition: One-parameter scans show no transition trend at all
decision_points.action: Widen parameter ranges before increasing seeds.
Increase runtime, resolution, and seed count locally.
Conclude current law set likely overdrives into collapse and revise dynamics rather than scanning blindly.

success_criteria.minimum_success: A credible regime map separating at least R1, R2, and R3.
success_criteria.strong_success: Identification of one or more candidate R4 bounded continuation windows.
success_criteria.best_success: R4 window survives longer runtime, higher resolution, and increased seed count.

failure_criteria.interpretive_failure: Metrics change during scan without version split.
failure_criteria.scientific_failure: Large scan is run without formal regime classification.
failure_criteria.practical_failure: Too many seeds are used before locating transition neighborhoods.

recommended_immediate_next_actions.action: Freeze current metric thresholds and schema into a batch config file.
Run P1 anchor confirmation: 3 IC x 2 seeds at current anchor point.
Classify runs into R1-R4 before moving to broader scans.

theory_safe_claim_after_completion.statement: Level 2 supports a regime-based interpretation in which exclusion-redistribution dynamics produce distinct qualitative continuation classes, and the presence or absence of bounded continuation can be investigated as a parameter-dependent question rather than assumed.
